payout_quote: Official italki Help: 'When a lesson or package is completed, italki charges a commission fee based on the teacher's listed lesson price and the type of lesson.' Commission table: Trial & Instant Lesson (trial) 0%; Single Lesson 21%; 5-Lesson Package 19%; 10-Lesson Package 17%; 15-Lesson Package 15%; 20-Lesson Package 15%; Group Class 30%. 'italki does not charge a commission fee for trial lessons.'
steps: Apply as an italki teacher; set your listed lesson prices.
Get approved; offer single lessons, packages, or group classes.
italki deducts the commission (0%-30% by lesson type); withdraw credits via Payoneer/bank (no withdrawal commission except express).
catches: Commission ranges 0% (trial) to 30% (group class); single lessons cost you 21% — you keep 70%-100% depending on lesson type.
Teachers set their own listed prices, so earnings are variable with no guaranteed students.
Must complete lessons to earn; packages incentivize lower commission but require student commitment.
Withdrawal via Payoneer/bank; payment method fees may apply.
biggest_catch: Commission takes up to 30% (group classes) and 21% on single lessons — your take-home depends heavily on which lesson types students buy, and you must set prices that survive the cut.
eligibility: Language teaching ability; approved italki teacher application.
timing: Paid per completed lesson/package; withdraw via Payoneer/bank transfer.
